text: 金十数据9月23日讯，据中科曙光公众号，9月23日，在河北召开的2026中国国际数字经济博览会期间，中科曙光与当地政务部门、龙头企业、行业学会及高校签署系列战略合作协议，推动国产算力供给与区域数据产业、工业应用和人才培养深度融合的长期布局。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 23 - According to the Zhongke曙光 official account, on September 23, during the 2026 China International Digital Economy Expo held in Hebei, Zhongke曙光 signed a series of strategic cooperation agreements with local government departments, leading enterprises, industry associations, and universities, promoting a long-term layout for deep integration of domestic computing power supply with regional data industry, industrial applications, and talent cultivation.
